'''Credi Solfinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Deaon/Legends|Deaon]] who served as an advisor to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nehanna]] of [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. After her disappearance, Solfinn became Acting [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He spent much of his time as regent continuing Nehanna's policies and attempting to find her.<ref name="Strongholds" />
